Devon's tax position for 2025–26 is not established."},{"id":"a4","status":"UNKNOWN","evidence_quote":"The only reference visible on that page belongs to an earlier gift, and the page setting out the declaration's coverage and duration is not in the scan","justification":"A partial scanned form exists but the pages confirming the declaration's scope and duration are missing, so it cannot be established that a valid Gift Aid declaration covering this donation is on record."},{"id":"a5","status":"TRUE","evidence_quote":"distinct from the employer deduction file, the securities transfer journal, and the charity-card and voucher processor's separately numbered settlement batch","justification":"The bank export explicitly distinguishes this transfer from the employer deduction (Payroll Giving) file, confirming it was not made through Payroll Giving."},{"id":"a6","status":"TRUE","evidence_quote":"the booking and sales registers show no related purchase or reservation; the only thing sent to Devon was the automated thank-you email","justification":"The scenario positively establishes no goods or services transaction is associated with this payment."},{"id":"a7","status":"TRUE","evidence_quote":"no discount or other benefit was offered","justification":"The scenario explicitly states Devon received no benefit in connection with the donation."},{"id":"a8","status":"TRUE","evidence_quote":"distinct from the employer deduction file, the securities transfer journal","justification":"The transfer is explicitly distinguished from the securities transfer journal, confirming it is not a donation of shares."},{"id":"a9","status":"TRUE","evidence_quote":"distinct from … the charity-card and voucher processor's separately numbered settlement batch","justification":"The payment is explicitly distinguished from the charity-card and voucher processor's batch, confirming it was not made via a charity card or vouchers."}],"scope_issues":["The customer scenario covers both recurring monthly direct-debit donors and one-off donors; this assessment addresses only the single £95 payment dated 1 March 2026 from Devon Gray.
